errors.text: The proposed Al-induced B2 network does not reconstruct the target intervention of 4.2 at.% Cr producing approximately 4 vol.% Cr2(Ti,Zr,Hf,Ta) Laves phase.
None of the cited evidence supports Al addition, B2 formation, or a reticulated HfAl/TiAl-rich phase in HfMoTaTiZr.
The density prediction is internally inconsistent, first describing a modest increase and then acknowledging that lightweight Al should decrease density.
The added heat-treatment route differs from the target as-cast vacuum-arc-melted intervention and is not justified by evidence.
